{{Top}} {{Update|[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]], [[The Mandalorian Junior Novel|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Junior Novel]], [[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season One)|The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season One]]}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Adam_Pally_Trooper_The_Mandalorian.png]] |name=AP-1982 |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[9 ABY]], [[Nevarro]] |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' establishes that the [[stormtrooper]]s of the [[Galactic Empire]] were all [[human]]s. |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 7: The Reckoning}} |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Gideon's Imperial remnant]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I'll give you 20 credits for the helmet.|AP-1982, to Greef Karga on Din Djarin's beskar helmet|}} '''AP-1982''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[scout trooper]] who served in an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Around [[9 ABY]], he guarded the entrance to [[Nevarro]]'s [[Nevarro City|city]] alongside [[JS-1975]], another scout [[trooper]], after Gideon's forces drove the city's residents away. After hearing a communication from [[Din Djarin]], the troopers took off and secured [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], whom Gideon wished to acquire. Arriving at the city's outskirts, they awaited for confirmation to enter until they were approached by [[IG-11]], who incapacitated them and secured the Child. ==Biography== ===Guarding the city=== {{Quote|Chain code?''"
"''I have a gift for the boss.''"
"''Chain code?|The scout trooper and Greef Karga|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]], AP-1982''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' was a [[scout trooper]] who served in an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. In [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|7}} the scout [[trooper]] guarded the entrance to [[Nevarro]]'s [[Nevarro City|city]] alongside another scout trooper, [[JS-1975]], after Gideon's forces forced its residents away. [[File:Troopers-Guarding-City-The-Mandalorian.png|thumb|left|250px|AP-1982 and JS-1975 guarding the entrance to Nevarro's city.]] When [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] agent [[Greef Karga]] brought [[Din Djarin]] in [[Stuncuffs|cuffs]], accompanied by [[Carasynthia Dune]] with [[Din Grogu|Grogu's]] pram, AP-1982 asked for his [[chain code]]. Karga initially avoided the demand, claiming he brought a gift for [[The Client|their leader]], but showed his code after AP-1982 demanded for it again. While scanning the code, he offered to pay twenty [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for [[Din Djarin's armor|Djarin's]] [[beskar]] [[helmet]], but Karga refused, stating that he would hang it on his wall. He then handed the code back to Karga and they proceeded inside the city. Sometime later, Gideon arrived in front of the city's [[Nevarro school|cantina]] with his forces, cornering Karga and his allies. The two troopers overheard a communication by Djarin, learning of the Child's true location. They immediately activated their [[speeder bike]]s and chased him down, finding him with the [[Ugnaught]] [[Kuiil]] and his [[blurrg]]. They fired at Kuiil, killing him and the blurrg he rode and dropping the Child. JS-1975 then picked up the infant and stuffed him into a sack, taking him back to the city and into the hands of Gideon, accompanied by AP-1982. ===Standing by=== {{Quote|What is that thing, anyway?''"
"''Uh, I don't know. Maybe Moff wants to eat it. I don't ask questions.|The troopers, questioning what the Child was|{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}}}} [[File:Troopers-Waiting-The-Mandalorian.png|thumb|right|250px|AP-1982 and JS-1975 standing by.]] Upon arriving at the city's outskirts, AP-1982 waited as JS-1975 hailed the operator and requested for confirmation to enter. He overheard the chatter and learned that Gideon's forces killed a squad of local troopers. Questioning the act, JS-1975 replied saying that officers like Gideon always enforced the law when they entered the town. AP-1982 questioned what was inside the sack, with JS-1975 replied stating that he did not question Gideon's actions. AP-1982 then asked if he could see it, but was refused and was reminded of what Gideon had done in the city just to make a statement, and was asked if he understood it. After stating that he did, AP-1982 pulled out his [[blaster]] and began taking shots at a nearby object out of boredom, but failed to land a single one. Prompting JS-1975 to do the same, the two attempted to hit the object, but failed to do so. AP-1982 then asked if they should provide [[water]] to the Child, but was called out by JS-1975, claiming that he only wanted to see him. AP-1982 replied stating that he got to see him as he stuffed him into the sack, but was told he could barely see the infant when picking him up and that he would not take the infant out until he was delivered to Gideon. [[File:IG-11-assault.png|thumb|left|250px|IG-11 incapacitates the troopers.]] After JS-1975 contacted the operator again, AP-1982 voiced his concerns over the Child's condition, stating he was knocked hard. He pointed out that Gideon would not be pleased with seeing the infant dead in the sack, prompting JS-1975 to open it and reveal the Child to him. As he inspected the Child by poking his forehead, the Child bit his finger, and AP-1982 punched him in response. Immediately afterwards, the two troopers were confronted by [[IG-11]], who stated he was the infant's [[Nanny droid|nurse droid]]. They pulled out their blasters, questioning his model as they thought [[IG-series|IG droids]] were usually [[bounty hunter]]s. As the droid approached them, he incapacitated AP-1982 with the sack and grabbed JS-1975's head, slamming him into his [[speeder]] and knocking him out. IG-11 then took the other bike with the Child in hand and headed towards the city. In the end, AP-1982's curious nature cost him his life.''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Shouldn't we check and see if it's still alive? You hit it pretty hard.''"
"''You just wanna see it.''"
"''Well, we should check and see if it's hurt.|AP-1982, to JS-1975|}} [[File:Acme-Checkpoint.png|thumb|right|300px|An intrigued AP-1982 studies the Child]] AP-1982 was mostly unfazed when being reminded of Gideon's actions in the city after asking if he could see the Child. He was initially concerned for the Child after he took a beating from JS-1975, but punched the infant himself after he bit AP-1982's finger while he inspected the baby. ==Equipment== AP-1982 was equipped with the same [[armor]] as other scout troopers,{{EA|subdomain=starwars|url=starwars/battlefront/planets|text=''Star Wars'' Battlefront Planets|nolive=1}} although it was visibly dirtier. He also possessed a [[74-Z speeder bike]] and an [[EC-17 hold-out blaster]], which were typically owned by other scout troopers.{{Film|VI}}''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Mando-scout-troopers.png|thumb|right|250px|Adam Pally and Jason Sudeikis as the scout troopers on ''The Mandalorian''{{'s}} set]] AP-1982 first appeared in "[[Chapter 7: The Reckoning]]" of the [[Disney+]] television show ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Deborah Chow]] and aired on [[December 18]], [[2019]].{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|date=2019-09-24|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf#page=1]|archivedate=20210623202717}} Credited as "Biker Scout Trooper #2," the character was played by [[Adam Pally]]. He was later identified in an update of the [[2015]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''. The name AP-1982 is derived from Adam Pally's initials and his year of birth. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of AP-1982}} *[[The Mandalorian Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian'' Junior Novel]] {{Ab|The Mandalorian Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 1|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 1]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 7: The Reckoning}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian 7|''The Mandalorian'' 7]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}} *''[[The Mandalorian: This is the Way]]'' *[[The Mandalorian 8|''The Mandalorian'' 8]] *''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' {{1stID|AP-1982}} ==Sources== *{{DisneyGallery|Directing}} *{{DisneyGallery|Connections}} *{{SW|url=series/the-mandalorian/chapter-7-guide|text="The Reckoning" Episode Guide | The Mandalorian}} *{{SW|url=series/the-mandalorian/chapter-8-guide|text="Redemption" Episode Guide | The Mandalorian}} *[[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season One)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One]] *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian - The Art & Imagery Collector's Edition, Volume Two]]'' *[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian: Guide to Season One|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'': Guide to Season One]] *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/scene-to-stats-scout-troopers|text=Scene to Stats: Scout Troopers}} *{{Databank|speeder-bike|speeder bike}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=AP-1982 |fr=AP-1982 |ja=AP-1982 |ka=AP-1982 |nl=AP-1982 }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of Gideon's Imperial remnant]] [[Category:Scout troopers]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of Imperial remnants]]
